title: int casts of int, byte and rat are exact at any size; a float source keeps the signed-64 check
purpose: Observe that int(...) never narrows an arbitrary-precision value (#309).

provenance.origin: authored for #309 from the owner's decision and spec 6.6.1
provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.6.1 (#309): int, byte and rat sources convert exactly (rat truncates toward zero); a float source is range-checked, and -2^63 and 9.2e18 are inside the range; values computed exactly in Python.
